content_sections.heading: Uttara Kannada District Court Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 78 vacancies are notified - 13 Process Server posts and 65 Peon posts - distributed across reservation categories as shown below. Each category total also includes horizontal reservation for women, rural candidates, persons with benchmark disabilities, ex-servicemen, Kannada-medium candidates, project-displaced persons, and transgender candidates, as applicable; the notification specifies these sub-splits in more detail than can be reliably reproduced here. Notes on the vacancy tables: Under SC (Category-C), preference is for the 59 identified Most Backward Castes; if suitable candidates are not available, other castes under Category-C will be considered. Benchmark disability reservation covers blindness and low vision, locomotor disability (including cerebral palsy, cured leprosy, dwarfism, acid attack victims, and multiple sclerosis/muscular dystrophy), and deaf/hard-of-hearing candidates, as defined in the notification's disability sub-categories. The notification also lists separate horizontal-reservation figures for women, rural candidates, ex-servicemen, Kannada-medium candidates, project-displaced persons, and transgender candidates within each category. These sub-splits were not reliably extractable from the scanned notification and are not reproduced here - candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact horizontal-reservation figures applicable to their category.

content_sections.heading: Uttara Kannada District Court Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Process Server: Pass in SSLC examination or equivalent qualification. Preference will be given to candidates holding a Heavy/Light Motor Vehicle (HMV/LMV) driving licence. Peon: Pass in SSLC examination or equivalent qualification. Candidates must be able to read and write Kannada. Candidates must have completed 18 years of age as on the last date fixed for submission of application, and must not exceed the following maximum age limits: As per Government Order No. ಸಿಆಸುಇ 262 ಸೇನೆನಿ 2025 dated 29 January 2026, an additional 5-year relaxation has been added to the maximum age limit above (this relaxation is limited to this one recruitment). Further age relaxation under Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977, Rule 6(2), applies as follows: Government/quasi-government/local authority/corporation employees: relaxation equal to the period of service rendered, or 10 years, whichever is less. Ex-servicemen: relaxation equal to the period of service in the armed forces, plus 3 years. Candidates with physical disability: 10 years relaxation. Widowed candidates: 10 years relaxation. The minimum and maximum age limits are calculated as on the last date for submitting the online application. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Uttara Kannada District Court Selection Process
content_sections.text: Process Server: Candidates are shortlisted for interview based on percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying educational examination, in a ratio of 1:25 per post (as per reservation for the notified posts). The interview carries a total of 10 marks. Peon: Candidates are shortlisted for interview based on percentage of marks obtained in the SSLC examination, in a ratio of 1:10 per post. The interview carries a total of 10 marks. Final selection for both posts is based on marks scored in the interview. If two or more candidates score equal marks, seniority in age is used to determine merit order, with the older candidate ranked higher.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Uttara Kannada District Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: uttarakannada.dcourts.gov.in/notice-category/recruitments/ or uttarakannada.dcourts.gov.in/online-recruitment/ . Read all instructions given on the online portal carefully before starting the application. Fill in the online application form with correct personal, educational, and category details, and a valid email address and mobile number (these cannot be corrected once submitted). Upload all required documents and certificates as specified on the portal. Pay the applicable fee online via the SBI Collect page and upload the fee payment receipt, on or before 17 September 2026, 11:59 PM. Submit the application on or before 16 September 2026, 11:59 PM. If more than one application is submitted, only the last submitted application will be considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Uttara Kannada District Court Application
content_sections.text: SSLC original marks card, or marks card of an equivalent qualification (for both education and date of birth proof) Original birth certificate (if SSLC marks card is not used for date-of-birth proof) Valid original caste/category certificate, in the prescribed Karnataka Government format, for SC/ST/Category-I/IIA/IIB/IIIA/IIIB candidates claiming reservation Persons with Benchmark Disabilities certificate from a competent authority, for candidates claiming disability reservation Discharge/release certificate from the District Sainik Board or competent authority, for ex-servicemen candidates Rural candidate certificate, in the prescribed format, for candidates claiming rural reservation Transgender certificate under Section 6 of the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019, for candidates claiming transgender reservation No Objection Certificate from the concerned department, for candidates already employed in State/Central Government or public sector undertakings, if selected Project-displaced person certificate, in the prescribed format as per Government Order dated 23.11.2000, for candidates claiming this reservation Identity proof: original Aadhaar card, voter ID, or similar document Character/conduct certificate: two certificates confirming good conduct from respectable persons (non-relatives) who know the candidate well, with signature and seal, plus one certificate from the head/principal of the last institution attended, with educational details, signature and seal - all obtained within the last six months HMV/LMV driving licence, where applicable (Process Server post, for preferential consideration) Fee payment receipt (for candidates who paid the applicable fee)

faq.question: Q1. What is Uttara Kannada District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Uttara Kannada, Karwar, under Notification No. 1/2026, to fill 13 Process Server and 65 Peon posts across subordinate courts in Uttara Kannada district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 78 vacancies in total - 13 Process Server posts and 65 Peon posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Uttara Kannada District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application can be submitted until 16 September 2026, 11:59 PM. Fee payment is allowed until 17 September 2026, 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: SSLC pass or equivalent qualification for both Process Server and Peon posts. Peon candidates must also be able to read and write Kannada, and Process Server candidates with an HMV/LMV driving licence get preference.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Uttara Kannada District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be at least 18 years old as on the last date for application. The maximum age is 40 years for General category, 43 years for Category-IIA/IIB/IIIA/IIIB, and 45 years for SC/ST/Category-I, with a further 5-year relaxation added as per the Government Order dated 29 January 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Uttara Kannada District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 300 for General category candidates, Rs. 150 for Category-IIA/IIB/IIIA/IIIB candidates, and no fee for SC, ST, Category-I, and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Uttara Kannada District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at uttarakannada.dcourts.gov.in, following the notice-category/recruitments or online-recruitment link, complete the form, upload documents, and pay the fee online before the deadlines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Uttara Kannada District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted for interview based on their qualifying exam marks (in a 1:25 ratio for Process Server and 1:10 ratio for Peon), and final selection is based on interview marks (10 marks each), with age used as a tie-breaker.
